resources.string: Nivara keeps your private space on this device, under your control.
A screen lock is set on this device.
Set a screen lock in system settings to protect this device.
This build contains the application shell only. Security modules are added in the releases that follow.
Nivara requests no permissions, blocks cleartext network traffic and disables cloud backup of application data.
Nivara could not load this screen.
A drawing that connects dots on a grid.
One method protects your private space. You can change it later.
At least four digits, and not a repeated or sequential run.
Length matters more than symbols. Eight characters is the minimum.
Connect at least four dots. Dots you cross on the way count too.
Confirming now means a typo cannot lock you out later.
The stored credential is replaced only after the current one is accepted.
Nivara will ask for it before it opens protected content.
Nivara neither shows nor stores what you enter.
That matches the credential configured on this device.
Set a credential up first; there is nothing to check against yet.
The stored credential cannot be read. Recovery arrives in a later release.
Pattern area. Drag across the dots to draw your pattern.
Too short. The minimum length is %1$d.
Too long. The maximum length is %1$d.
That credential contains characters that are not allowed.
That choice is too easy to guess. Pick another one.
That is not a valid pattern.
The two entries do not match.
A credential is already set up. Use change instead.
The stored credential cannot be used.
Too many attempts. Try again in %1$d s.
Nivara could not complete that. Try again.
Choose a PIN, password or pattern to protect your private space.
Nivara asks for this credential before it opens protected content.
Biometric unlock is a faster way to authenticate. It never replaces your primary credential, which keeps working in every situation below.
Confirm your primary credential to change biometric settings.
Biometric unlock is off, and its key has been removed.
Nivara paused biometric attempts. Try again in %1$d s, or use your primary credential below to clear the pause.
Android can lock biometrics on its own after repeated failures. Nivara cannot lift that lockout, and does not try to.
Biometric unlock has to be set up again
Android confirms your identity before this convenience path opens.
You can turn it on after setting up a primary credential.
The device biometric enrolment changed, so the stored key can no longer be used. Your primary credential is unchanged.
Biometric unlock stays off. Use your primary credential instead.
This device has no biometric sensor
The biometric sensor is not available right now
No biometric is enrolled on this device
This device cannot use biometrics for this app
Android requires a security update before biometrics can be used
Biometrics are not available right now
Enter your %1$s to confirm this change. The credential itself is never stored.
No primary credential is set up yet. Set one up first: biometric unlock is only a shortcut for it.
Set up your primary credential first. Biometric unlock never replaces it.
Nivara paused biometric attempts. Try again in %1$d s.
Android has locked biometrics for now. Nivara cannot lift that lockout. Use your primary credential, or unlock the device with its own screen lock and try again later.
Android has disabled biometrics until the device is unlocked with its own screen lock. Nivara cannot lift that lockout.
Biometric unlock can no longer be used, because the device biometric enrolment changed. Your primary credential is unchanged; turn biometric unlock on again to set it up anew.
Android could not provide the biometric key.
Nivara could not complete that. Try again.
Authenticate to turn on biometric unlock.
Authenticate to turn off biometric unlock.
Nivara locks itself after a period of inactivity, and whenever you lock it. Nothing is kept on disk, so closing the app ends the session too.
Opened with your primary credential. Biometrics stay a shortcut, and the credential still works on its own.
Opened with Android biometrics. Your primary credential is unchanged and still works on its own.
Nivara is locked. Authenticate again to continue.
The session ended. Authenticate again to continue.
This is Nivara\'s own session, not the device\'s screen lock: locking it does not touch your credential, your biometric enrolment or any stored file.
